title: 第17章 她被关祠堂
lines: 但真正的风暴，才刚刚开始。

content_zh:
宫宴的混乱还没散尽。

    但真正的风暴，才刚刚开始。

    迟息散的事，被强行压了下去。

    表面上，是内侍误饮。

    但所有人都知道——

    那杯茶，本该落在苏晚身上。

    而她，躲过去了。

    不仅躲过去了。

    还“借势救人”。

    让苏柔的局，变成了一场当众失控的反噬。

    苏柔被禁足。

    但禁足的第三日，她就见到了一个人。

    ——继母。

    屋内灯光很暗。

    继母坐在阴影里。

    苏柔站在门口，脸色苍白。

    “娘……我不是故意的。”

    她声音发抖。

    继母没有看她。

    只是慢慢开口：

    “你动了最不该动的东西。”

    苏柔一愣。

    “什么？”

    继母抬眼。

    “她的‘反应路径’。”

    苏柔听不懂。

    继母却已经不想解释。

    她站起身。

    走到窗前。

    “苏晚现在已经不是‘防守型的人’了。”

    “她在引导局。”

    苏柔咬牙：

    “那我们就再做一次！”

    “我不信她每次都能赢！”

    继母看着她。

    眼神第一次有了冷意。

    “你还没看清楚吗？”

    苏柔一愣。

    继母缓缓说：

    “你每一次出手。”

    “都在给她提供数据。”

    空气一瞬间冷了下来。

    苏柔手指发抖。

    “那我什么都不能做吗？！”

    继母没有回答。

    只是低声说了一句：

    “你已经被她标记了。”

    苏柔脸色彻底白了。

    “标记？”

    继母点头。

    “她现在看你。”

    “不是在看一个对手。”

    她顿了一下。

    “是在看一个‘样本’。”

    与此同时。

    苏晚在宫中偏殿。

    她正在给一名宫女换药。

    那宫女手上有烫伤。

    很轻。

    但苏晚处理得极细致。

    像在修复一件器物。

    宫女忍不住低声问：

    “苏姑娘……那日的事……真的是误会吗？”

    苏晚没有抬头。

    “不是误会。”

    宫女一愣：

    “那是……”

    苏晚轻声：

    “是试探。”

    她说得很平静。

    平静得像在讲天气。

    宫女低声：

    “谁在试您？”

    苏晚停了一瞬。

    然后说：

    “很多人。”

    她换完药，起身。

    走到窗边。

    看着宫墙外的天。

    “他们现在开始变聪明了。”

    她轻声说。

    “但还不够。”

    夜里。

    相府暗线传来消息。

    “苏柔欲见外人。”

    “疑似再布新局。”

    继母听完，没有立刻说话。

    只是轻轻放下茶盏。

    “让她做。”

    下人一愣：

    “夫人？”
content_en:
The prime minister's "fear" did not stop the bureau.

    On the contrary, it made some people even more anxious.

    Su Rou has not been discharged from the hospital for three days.

    But she was not idle.

    On the contrary, she barely slept in the past three days.

    She is waiting for an opportunity.

    An opportunity to completely kill Su Wan.

    at night.

    She sat in front of the candlelight and slowly traced a small porcelain bottle with her fingers.

    The bottle is very ordinary.

    It's as common as the heat-clearing powder that's readily available in pharmacies.

    But the thing inside is not medicine.

    It's poison.

    colorless.

    Tasteless.

    It doesn't even happen right away.

    ——"Chixisan".

    She bought it from outside at a high price.

    The medicine seller only said one sentence:

    "This poison will not kill anyone in an instant."

    "It only makes people lose their breath on the most important occasions."

    Su Rou smiled.

    What she wants is this effect.

    Not letting Su Wan die.

    Let her——

    When "rescuing people", they can't be saved.

    "Miss, wouldn't this be too risky?"

    The maid's voice trembled.

    Su Rou glanced at her.

    "Adventure?"

    She chuckled.

    "I have no way out."

    She paused.

    "From the day she started to become 'Su Wan'."

    She raised her hand and handed the porcelain bottle to the maid.

    "Tomorrow's Palace Banquet."

    "The Queen Mother will attend."

    "The imperial doctor will accompany you."

    She said softly:

    "As long as she takes action."

    "Just let her fail once in public."

    The maid's face turned pale:

    "But...if we are found out..."

    Su Rou's eyes turned cold.

    "Can't find out."

    She whispered:

    "This is no ordinary poison."

    "It's a 'symptomatic poison'."

    "It just makes it look like - like a relapse."

    She paused.

    "And."

    "I'm not going to let it happen to me."

    She smiled softly.

    "I'll make it happen to someone else."

    The second day.

    Palace banquet.

    The lights are as bright as day.

    All the officials gathered.

    Even the Queen Mother rarely attended.

    Because today, there is one thing——

    Review of old post-war diseases in the North.

    King Zhenbei is also here.

    Su Wan was named to accompany him.

    This was her first time to truly enter the "core field of the palace."

    Not a side hall.

    Not a summons.

    But - in front of everyone.

    The banquet has just started.

    Everything seems normal.

    Singing and dancing.

    The aroma of wine overflows.

    But as soon as Su Wan came in, she felt something was wrong.

    odor.

    Too "clean".

    Unnaturally clean.

    It's like someone deliberately cleared the scene.

    She said nothing.

    Just take a seat.

    King Zhenbei sat not far away and glanced at her.

    There was a hint of reminder in his eyes.

    Su Wan nodded.

    means she knows.

    The palace banquet is halfway through.

    The Queen Mother suddenly spoke.

    "The king of Zhenbei has not recovered from his old illness."

    "It's a good time for Dr. Su to take a look today."
title_en: Chapter 16 The aunt begins to fight back
